nativeWalk.error: Native walker blocked on planned public path

improvements: The Great Wheel ride now requires three full visible turns before completion; early departure does not award it and cancellation restores the saved shore pose.
All source buildings remain represented through exact geometry, including pier context previously affected by blanket exclusions.
Actual native walking reaches Pier 57 around the complete retained ticket queue; source geometry and all people remain unchanged.
remainingGaps: The static guided planner ignores crowd bodies and still hits the ticket queue after 78.4m. A read-only crowd-aware test plan proves the public scene route is accessible, without changing runtime navigation.
The posed activity-approach image still faces the brick ticket frontage at close range; it is not proof of the walking approach.
The broader Ocean Pavilion/Overlook route was not established by this bounded walk; the sidecar planner returned no route from the crowded board endpoint, not an actual failed native walk.
Six visitors remain below or sunk into the local deck surface; pier deck seams also require physical z-fighting repair.
Promenade, Miners Landing frontages, pier outlines and Overlook Walk need complete matched current references; the captured scene remains simplified.
Raw audit findings remain for physical review: zfight 45, pedBelow 6, pedSunk 6.
historicalCollections.review: All four refreshed GAME context views and actual Pier 57 walk inspected. Physical public access passes around the queue; the guided-planner limitation and raw crowd/deck findings remain explicit.
